trigger: All four completed added-chirality control endpoints, including both experimental native-fold controls, exceed the 25-degree minimized-peptide threshold at one or more bonds during thermal motion. No alpha inversions or gross bond failure is implied by this angular threshold.
interpretation: A minimized-structure peptide gate cannot be applied blindly to a single thermal frame. Preserve every raw failure as a diagnostic, not evidence of loss of fold.
correction: Apply the unchanged strict numerical geometry thresholds after identically quenching each of the twelve final endpoints with Amber99SB/OBC, 500 minimizer iterations, no added positional or chirality restraints. Require this phase-matched check for new-candidate promotion. The already declared loop-motion and pH criteria remain unchanged.
